description: List the models this account can generate with, grouped by what they make: each with its id, the scenes (input modes such as 'text-to-3d' or 'image-to-3d') it supports, and the credits it costs at default options. A scene priced by how much of an input it reads (a video tool billed per second of the uploaded clip, speech billed per 1,000 characters) has credits null and a usage_price instead: the rate, its unit, the input it is measured from and the range a run can cost. include_inputs adds the option fields of each scene (names, allowed values, ranges). presets lists the ready-made picture conversions of Image Maker (figurine, style, pose, …), each an image-to-image run that names the preset in options.preset. batches lists the scenes that can run over several Library pictures at once, with the models each may use.

available_only.description: Leave out models that are listed but cannot be started.

include_inputs.description: Include the option fields of every scene (larger result).

media_type.description: Only models of this kind: '3d', 'image', 'video' or 'speech'.

name: list_models

batches.description: Scenes a batch can run over several pictures; empty when the app offers none.

max_items.description: Most pictures any plan may batch; the account’s own allowance is in its batch listing.

available.description: False for a model that is listed but cannot be started yet.

credits_from.description: The least a run can cost: the cheapest scene at default options, or for a usage-priced scene the price of its smallest input (usage_price.min_credits). Options and input size can raise it; a price estimate for the exact options gives the real figure.

family.description: The product line this model is a release of; null for a model with no sibling releases. Every release is a model id of its own.

id.description: The model id a price estimate or a generation names.

kind.description: The control type, e.g. text, long-text, choice, number, toggle, count, seed, media (upload URLs), library, repeat (a list of items) or hidden.

options.description: The allowed values of a choice; null for other kinds.

value_type.description: The JSON shape to send: string, number, boolean, string[], object or object[].

item.description: For repeat: one item's controls. Send a list of objects, each holding these controls' values by id; null for other kinds.

kind.description: The control type, e.g. text, long-text, choice, number, toggle, count, seed, media (upload URLs), library, repeat (a list of items) or hidden.

max_items.description: For repeat: the most items to send; null for other kinds.

min_items.description: For repeat: the fewest items to send; null for other kinds.

options.description: The allowed values of a choice; null for other kinds.

value_type.description: The JSON shape to send: string, number, boolean, string[], object or object[].

inputs.description: Option fields per scene; null unless include_inputs is true.

latest.description: True for a family's newest release (and for a model with no family). False marks an older release that a newer one replaced: pin it only to reproduce earlier work.

retires_at.description: The UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) the provider retires this model, when one is announced; null otherwise. After it, the model can no longer be generated.

credits.description: Credits at default options; null when the scene is priced by usage (see usage_price).
Credits for `per` units, with every other option at its default.

max_credits.description: What a run of max_units costs; null with max_units.

max_units.description: The most units one run may hold; null when uncapped.

measured_input.description: The option whose length is billed (an upload or a text field). An upload’s length is measured by the server from the stored file, never taken from the request.

min_credits.description: What a run of min_units costs.

min_units.description: The fewest units a run is billed for.

per.description: How many units `credits` buys: 1 second, 1000 characters.

rounding.description: 'units': every started block of `per` units is billed whole (12.4 s counts as 13 s). 'total': billed pro rata, the total rounded up to a whole credit.

usage_price.description: For a scene priced by how much of an input it reads (a clip’s seconds, a text’s characters): the rate and the range a run can cost. Null for a fixed price.

version.description: This release's label within its family, e.g. 'v7.1'; null with family.

presets.description: Image presets this app offers; empty when it has none or media_type is not image.

addons.description: Ids for options.preset_addons; empty when the preset has none.

aspect_ratio.description: The frame the preset is tuned for; options.aspect_ratio overrides.

family.description: figurine, style, pose or convert: the kind of conversion.

id.description: Pass as options.preset to generate (mediaType 'image', scene 'image-to-image').

images.description: How many pictures a run takes in options.image: the subject first, then an optional reference.

instructions_max_length.description: prompt on a preset run is only your additional instructions, at most this long.

models.description: Image models it can run on in this account’s app.
